summary: The team reviewed branch readiness, error metrics, support requirements, rollback procedures, privacy compliance, success criteria, and budget for the library booking pilot, deciding to conduct a restricted two-branch pilot with twenty invited patrons each at Harbour and Cedar, scheduled for Friday, October ninth, subject to conditions.
decisions: Scale down the launch from a twelve-branch public release to a pilot with twenty invited patrons each at the Harbour and Cedar branches.
Pause new invitations if support receives more than five pilot tickets in a day, while keeping existing reservations active.
Trigger an immediate stop to new bookings in the event of a confirmed double booking or data exposure, moving existing reservations to a staff-managed spreadsheet.
Keep pilot invitations as drafts until written privacy approval is received.
Approve a two-hundred-dollar budget cap for the first month of the two-branch pilot.

Set the success criteria to include ten days of observation, at least thirty completed patron bookings, zero double bookings, and at most five percent needing help with basic booking, excluding staff test bookings.
Change the launch schedule from Monday to Friday, October ninth, with staggered batches for Harbour at ten and Cedar at noon, conditional on written privacy approval and passing staff tests.
